Candidate A is the base. The independent cross-judge scored A 20/20 and B 18/20 for text compatibility, ranked JSON clarity, simplicity, and CLI verification. Keep the text printer unchanged and add an inline JSON branch. Both formats share the ordered tuples from most_common.
